name: REVEL
verdict: Private Spanish car-subscription company (Drive REVEL S.L.); KKR and Santander Consumer Finance hold minority stakes. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Founder-led private company; investor stakes (KKR, Santander Consumer Finance) undisclosed and minority. No state body or fund found anywhere in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN body or major-NGO human-rights finding against REVEL found.
